correctness.rationale: For the stated even rational window g(x)=(x^2-1)/((x^2+1)(x^2+4)(x^2+9)) and alpha beta=4/5, the modulus-integer fiberization yields a continuous 4-by-5 matrix M_{j,t}=sum_m g((j+4m-4t/5)/beta). Reflection j->4-j, t->5-t decomposes row space into dimensions 3 and 1, and its even 3-by-3 block B has exactly the supplied h_beta coefficients; recomputed the reflection basis entries. The absolutely convergent Cauchy-series partial fractions give h_beta. Independently evaluated determinant at beta=3/20 as +2.1035333493165e-6 and beta=7/20 as -5.68237067634317e-6; the pinned verify_gabor_4_5.py uses rational interval bounds for pi, exp, cosine and the determinant, and its rational truncation/tail arguments were inspected. IVT yields a singular fiber for an intermediate beta. Local uniform convergence ensures continuity of fibers, hence singularity forces arbitrarily small singular values on positive-measure neighborhoods and excludes a positive Gabor frame lower bound. Proof establishes existence at one beta, not all beta at this product.
